name: SkyAphid/ClearDialogue
description: A free open-source engine-agnostic branching dialogue editor for video games, built with Java, featuring node-based editing and JSON export for any game engine integration.
score_rationale: Engine-agnostic branching dialogue editor with only 34 stars, last updated in 2019 — effectively abandoned and superseded by more active tools.
summary: Legacy engine-agnostic branching dialogue editor abandoned in 2019
